speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. As it was this morning. She sees him. That is the last of it. I am not proud of stopping, and I am not sorry either.

speaker: richard_field
text: A shut leaf is a man who can be walked as far as a corner. Not before. Thou hast done the shutting. I will do the corner when the cloak is on, and not a yard past it.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The fold stays a fold. If you open it on the stair to improve a line, you will be back in that chair, and I will not be glad. I am glad now. Briefly.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays a fold. The cloak is going on. The cups are yours.
